column1: # TERRY PAPER_BOOK.tsv — PHASE-1 SHADOW BOOK (PAPER — NOT REAL, NOT AN ENDORSED P&L)
# WHAT THIS IS: an auto-filled CARD-QUALITY track record. Every card that reaches
#   would-fire state is paper-filled here at realistic marks (ask-for-buys / bid-for-
#   sells at the trigger timestamp, NEVER mid) and tracked to close, INDEPENDENT of
#   Will's approval gate. Purpose: manufacture a falsifiable record to attack PAT-028
#   (0 cards fired live -> 0 track record). Measures PROCESS calibration (structure /
#   timing / sizing / the pass decision) — NOT behavioral/execution edge.
# GUARDRAILS (PAPER_BOOK_DESIGN.md 'Standing guardrails' — do not violate):
#   1. PAPER. Every row is paper. This is NOT a real return and NOT a P&L Will approved.
#   2. NEVER a license to size up live. It calibrates process; it is not an argument
#      for looser real deployment. Auto-fill measures card quality, not an endorsed P&L.
#   3. SAME RULES as the real book — same triggers, same $500/card cap, same discipline.
#   4. SURVIVORSHIP: never delete a losing row; every fill is logged + marked in place.
#   5. FILL FIDELITY: buys at ASK, sells at BID, at the trigger timestamp; wide-spread
#      (bid/ask>15% of mid) penalty; entry_basis records the exact quote+timestamp
#      (auditable). Trigger while market closed -> fill at next open. Never mid.
#      entry_basis FORMAT (PROME spec ruled 2026-07-20): carry the FULL instrument id
#      with expiry LABELED as `exp YYYY-MM-DD` --
#      `<UNDERLYING> exp <YYYY-MM-DD> <STRIKE><C/P> <SIDE> <px> @ <ts ET> (<provenance>); spread <b/a>=<n>% <verdict>; <day-color>`
#      Why: "77P" is ambiguous once >1 TLT 77P series exists; and labeling `exp` stops
#      date-parsers (firetime_check) reading the expiry as a catalyst/docket date.
#   6. SMALL-N: no Brier/calibration scoring + no decision acts on this record until
#      N>=10 CLOSED positions per lane. Until then rows carry 'N-too-small'.
#   7. MARKS are as-of-last-spawn (TERRY is on-demand, not continuous): lumpy, stamped,
#      staleness-flagged. The equity curve is NOT continuous — never pretend it is.
# will_decision key: APPROVED / PASSED / NO-DECISION. The PASSED subset = the refusal-
#   calibration 'ghost' (did the discipline to say no save or cost money).
# Marking: paper_book_mark.py marks OPEN rows at chain MID + flags STALE (>N business
#   days). Fill rule reference + full spec: PAPER_BOOK_DESIGN.md.
